title: Finite-type subideal representatives of first cohomology
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $I$ be a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf [pqf-def-coherent]. Every $x\in H^1(X,I)$ [pqf-def-cohomology] is $H^1(X,f)(y)$ for some quasi-coherent subideal $K\subseteq I$ of finite type, some $y\in H^1(X,K)$, and an inclusion morphism $f:K\to I$ whose composite with $I\to\mathcal O_X$ is $K\to\mathcal O_X$.

source.place: Tag 01XG, first two sentences of proof, with Tags 01PG and 01FF

proof.text: Index the finite-type quasi-coherent subideals K of I by inclusion. The zero ideal belongs to the family and sums give upper bounds. Use directedOn_ofFiniteType_le and sSup_ofFiniteType_le_eq. Construct their inclusions as module-sheaf maps, compatible with the inclusions into the structure sheaf. Over affine opens range_toModulesι_app identifies their images with K.ideal. Their union is I.ideal, so compatible maps glue uniquely on local sections to a map from I.toModules. This proves that I.toModules is the colimit of the diagram. Finite local generators of K.ideal give K.toModules.IsFiniteType.

The compact opens of a scheme form a basis (affine opens form a compact basis). Quasi-separatedness supplies compact intersections, and X is compact. Apply openModuleCohomology_directedColimit to the preceding colimit at the top open in degree 1. Its surjectivity clause gives a stage class whose image is the prescribed class.

Compare module-valued global cohomology with group-valued cohomology at the top open. Both use the same injective module resolution. The exact forgetful functor from global modules to abelian groups preserves homology, so it identifies the groups naturally in the module sheaf. Transport the class and the equality from the previous step across this natural identification. The stage K and its cocone map f satisfy K ≤ I, finite type, and f followed by the inclusion of I is the inclusion of K. When I is zero or X is empty the zero stage and zero class still work.

lean.statement:
theorem ideal_h1_finiteType_representative (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (_hI : I.toModules.IsQuasicoherent)
    (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj I.toModules) :
    ∃ (K : X.IdealSheafData), K ≤ I ∧ K.toModules.IsFiniteType ∧
      ∃ (f : K.toModules ⟶ I.toModules)
        (y : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj K.toModules),
        f ≫ I.toModulesι = K.toModulesι ∧
          ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).map f).hom y = x
